title: First matching 64-bit element in a released Guava array
summary: Transfer the checked first-index rule from signed int cells to signed long cells on the same Guava artifact.

change.description: Compare the released search with a deliberately constructed last-match traversal.

verdictLabel: First-index holdout at two bounds and every legal length
notes: This holdout uses the exact Guava 33.4.8-jre JAR from example 336. Array lengths, returned indexes and the decreasing measure stay signed 32-bit. Each element and the target occupy 64 bits. The initial public induction attempt is retained before extending the rule.
